title: Retracting sweep symbols to the source alphabet
statement: Given a symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, a nonnegative integer $k$, and a distinguished symbol $a_0 \in \Gamma$, the retraction from the enlarged sweep alphabet to $\Gamma$ fixes each symbol of $\Gamma$ and sends every other symbol to $a_0$.
